note: P01 carries the "CHAPTER 13" heading plus the chapter title and the opening text, and there is no numbered heading for it, so from_heading is "unsure" for the introductory subtopic; the chapter summary (P32) and exercises (P33), which range over the whole chapter, are attached to that same subtopic so every passage is covered. P22 is a bare heading passage ("13.2 BIODIVERSITY CONSERVATION") with no body text of its own; it is attached to the first subtopic under 13.2 rather than being given a subtopic of its own. Section 13.1.2 covers two separate patterns (latitudinal gradients and species-area relationships) and 13.2.2 covers in situ, ex situ and international measures, so those sections were split accordingly.
